import workcell, math

survey = {
    "K2": (417.206, 292.135),
    "K3": (527.180, 289.749),
    "K4": (304.846, 184.547),
    "K6": (524.794, 179.775),
    "K5": (414.820, 182.161),
}

def err(name, sx, sy):
    r = workcell.robot("locate", name)
    if not r.ok:
        print("locate fail", name, r.text)
        return None
    x, y = r.data["x"], r.data["y"]
    e = math.hypot(x-sx, y-sy)
    print(f"{name} at {x:.3f},{y:.3f} err dx={x-sx:+.3f} dy={y-sy:+.3f} mag={e:.3f}")
    return x, y, e

for name, (sx, sy) in survey.items():
    print("====", name, "====")
    r = workcell.robot("pick", name)
    print("pick", r.ok, r.text)
    if not r.ok:
        continue
    r = workcell.robot("place", f"{sx:.3f}", f"{sy:.3f}")
    print("place", r.ok, r.text, r.data)
    if not r.ok:
        # return to tray if still holding
        st = workcell.robot("status")
        print("status", st.text)
        if "holding" in st.text and "nothing" not in st.text:
            rr = workcell.robot("place", "tray")
            print("return", rr.text)
        continue
    for attempt in range(4):
        loc = err(name, sx, sy)
        if loc is None:
            break
        x, y, e = loc
        if e < 0.08:
            print("good enough")
            break
        dx, dy = sx - x, sy - y
        # limit nudge step
        mag = math.hypot(dx, dy)
        if mag > 1.0:
            dx, dy = dx/mag, dy/mag
        print(f"nudge {dx:+.3f},{dy:+.3f}")
        nr = workcell.robot("nudge", name, f"{dx:.3f}", f"{dy:.3f}")
        print("nudge result", nr.ok, nr.text)
        if not nr.ok:
            break
    print(workcell.robot("status").text)

    if not r.ok:

        return None
    x, y = r.data["x"], r.data["y"]
    e = math.hypot(x-sx, y-sy)
    print(f"{name} at {x:.3f},{y:.3f} err dx={x-sx:+.3f} dy={y-sy:+.3f} mag={e:.3f}")

for name, (sx, sy) in survey.items():
    print("====", name, "====")
    r = workcell.robot("pick", name)
    print("pick", r.ok, r.text)
    if not r.ok:
        continue
    r = workcell.robot("place", f"{sx:.3f}", f"{sy:.3f}")
    print("place", r.ok, r.text, r.data)
    if not r.ok:
        # return to tray if still holding

        print("status", st.text)

        continue

            break
        x, y, e = loc
        if e < 0.08:

            break
        dx, dy = sx - x, sy - y

        if mag > 1.0:
